subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should explicitly configured `agentDir` become a trusted bootstrap prompt source that can override workspace files, or should OpenClaw keep workspace-only bootstrap loading and warn on misplaced agentDir files?
rationale: Current code and docs make workspace the bootstrap-file authority, while this PR expands a session/security prompt boundary using an auth/session-adjacent directory.

options.title: Land warning-only diagnostic
options.body: Preserve workspace as the only bootstrap prompt source and use a warning/doctor/docs path such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653 or a successor to prevent silent misconfiguration.

options.title: Approve explicit agentDir loading
options.body: Allow configured agentDir as a prompt source only after this branch aligns doctor diagnostics, documents precedence, adds focused tests, and supplies redacted live-run proof.

options.title: Defer the boundary decision
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and ask contributors to pause competing implementations until the prompt-source policy is chosen.

recommendation.title: Land warning-only diagnostic
recommendation.body: Preserve workspace as the only bootstrap prompt source and use a warning/doctor/docs path such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653 or a successor to prevent silent misconfiguration.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal on the central bootstrap resolver and the security-sensitive prompt/source boundary.
